name: breakhis-uni-linear-v1
normalization: field-moments-v2; fitting46 equal-case per-view first and second raw-field moments in float64; saved mean/std float32; std<=1e-6 replaced by1
input: standardized single frozen UNI2-h field feature in float32 plus four one-hot magnification indicators; dimension1540; no L2 or metric scaling
aggregation: compose per-field joint five-class probabilities; arithmetic mean within each view; arithmetic mean across available views; derive case binary and conditional malignant probabilities from pooled joint distribution
numerics: logsumexp for each probability mean and conditional distribution, finite saved log probabilities, explicit hard routing using exp(case binary log probability)>=0.5
selection: earliest maximum validation end-to-end five-class mean15-subset macro F1 within four C settings per arm; same C shared by binary and malignant heads
fitting_evaluation: in-sample resubstitution; optimizer and normalizer use fitting cases only
primary_comparison: UNI2-h field logistic dual versus accepted same-reader UNI2-h KDE dual on both arrangements
technical_smoke: 812/trial1 full46-fitting support; all four Cs and all three heads; fitting-only score one query per final label across15subsets;12headfits,8archives,600dependentrecords; no validation scoring
interpretation: standard frozen UNI2-h probabilistic linear field readout, distinct from the separately registered metric family; changed feature scaling and supervised classifier relative to same-reader KDE; adaptive reader choice and reused provider-case validation; no novelty or95 guarantee
